method.selection: Each fold evaluates and selects low-R edge subsets only on train years, then exact-replays the selected subset on the next unseen test year.
method.approximation_note: Train-only subset prefilter sums independently replayed single-edge train stats; selected candidates are exact-replayed with original concurrency rules before the next-year test replay.

decision.reason: No train-only selected forced-1.5R low-R subset passed every next-year 55% win-rate, trade-floor, and positive-PnL gate.
